item.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'

item.title: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger
item.description: An aeroplane flying to Israel fell 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes before it was diverted.
